evidence.title: Receipts piling up
evidence.body: 18,420 receipts are waiting and the oldest has waited 23 minutes. Payments still go through.

evidence.title: Busy workers, no progress
evidence.body: Receipt workers sit at 38% CPU, acknowledge 12 receipts a minute and retry 880.

evidence.title: Repeated receipt retry trace
evidence.body: One legacy-format message is retried ahead of valid receipts.

evidence.title: Support impact report
evidence.body: Jin confirms that receipts are delayed while payment transactions still complete.

evidence.title: Partner batch comparison
evidence.body: Batch 781 contains the malformed receipt while adjacent batches use the accepted format.

evidence.title: Redacted queue marker
evidence.body: A transient UNKNOWN marker points to a request preceding batch 781.

beats.narrate: A week into the rotation. This time the pager is only SEV2.

beats.speaker: PAGER
beats.text: SEV2 · Receipt Worker · oldest receipt message older than 15 minutes

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: I'm stuck on the database bridge. This one's yours — ping me only if it burns.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Receipts are late. Nobody has confirmed that payments failed.

beats.narrate: The change notice from build 1847 still leads nowhere. You checked twice more this week.
Nobody on the bridge mentions the release annotation anymore.
Sam has started a thread about who can write release annotations. It has no replies.

beats.log: receipt parser rejected the same message on repeated attempts

beats.narrate: Four thousand attempts at the same receipt. Everything behind it waits its turn.

options.consequence: Fast · the backlog will come back

beats.narrate: The new consumers chew through the easy receipts. Three minutes later the depth turns around.
More workers, same receipt at the head of the line.

options.text: Ask Jin whether payments are actually failing
options.consequence: Slower · you'll know what customers see

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Payments complete. People are waiting on receipts — a few tickets call it a payment outage, but it isn't one.

beats.narrate: While Jin answers, the worker log repeats the same receipt number.

beats.log: partner batch 780: receipt_v4 ×2000 · batch 781: receipt_v4 ×1999, legacy_v3 ×1 · batch 782: receipt_v4 ×2000

beats.narrate: One receipt in one partner batch, in a format nobody has sent for a year. It sits at the head of its partition and nothing gets past it.

scenes.title: Your call

beats.narrate: Nobody is going to make this decision for you. Or almost nobody.

scenes.prompt: What happens to the stuck receipt?

beats.speaker: PLATFORM
beats.text: auto-remediation: head-of-line message exceeded retry budget · action: discard

options.text: Quarantine the malformed receipt for reconciliation
options.consequence: One message set aside · someone fixes it by hand

beats.narrate: The partition drains in under a minute. Message 44 waits in quarantine with a ticket attached.

options.text: Add a dead-letter rule for the legacy format
options.consequence: Stops the whole class of failure · catches more than this one

beats.narrate: The queue drains. Over the next hour, receipts from three other partners land in the dead-letter queue too.

options.text: Discard the receipt and let the queue run
options.consequence: Fastest · one customer never gets a receipt

beats.narrate: Message 44 is gone. Somewhere a customer has paid and will never be told so.
The queue is quiet. You scroll back through the partition to see how the receipt got there.
Just before batch 781 there is one more request. Its body is redacted. Under it, a marker.

beats.log: UNKNOWN: check the request that arrived before batch 781.

beats.narrate: Three incidents. Three messages. None of them came from a service you can find.

scenes.title: End of the week
scenes.prompt: What do you do with the redacted request?

options.text: Open a ticket asking who redacted the request
options.consequence: On the record · questions will follow

options.text: Note the timestamp and say nothing
options.consequence: It stays between you and whoever wrote it

options.text: Pull Maya off her bridge and show her the marker
options.consequence: She asked to see the next one

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: ...Okay. That's not a glitch. Don't put this in a ticket yet. Let's find out who reads our tickets first.
